title: Zesty Energizing Turkish Ground Ginger Manti
description: Turkish dish made with ground ginger and a hint of nutmeg. Perfect for diabetic-friendly breakfast or snack.
instructions: Combine ground ginger, flour, egg, melted butter, sour cream, nutmeg, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 20 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a teaspoon of your favorite filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square, and press the edges together to seal the manti.
Place the manti on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with a little bit of water and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook the manti for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream or a sprinkle of sumac.
